findings.title: Superseded Indian Standard Cited: IS 14220:1994
findings.tender_text: requirements of IS 14220:1994 ("Openwell Submersible Pumpsets - Specification").
findings.explanation: The tender cites 'IS 14220:1994', which has been officially superseded by 'IS 14220:2018'. Procurement specifications citing obsolete standard editions violate public procurement rules and lead to rejection during technical and audit inspections.

evidence.factual_summary: Official BIS standard title and catalog record designate IS 14220:2018 as First Revision replacing original 1994 edition.

suggested_fix.replacement_clause_text: The equipment shall strictly comply with active Indian Standard IS 14220:2018.
suggested_fix.recommended_action_summary: Replace obsolete reference 'IS 14220:1994' with active standard 'IS 14220:2018'.

findings.title: Standard-Required Acceptance Test Standard Omitted: IS 11346
findings.tender_text: Section 7: Quality Assurance & Inspection (Test method standard absent)
findings.explanation: The governing product standard IS 14220 explicitly stipulates that hydraulic performance, tolerances, and acceptance tests shall be conducted in accordance with IS 11346 (Test Standard IS 11346). Omitting this standard leaves test methodologies and tolerance bands legally unanchored.

evidence.factual_summary: Standard IS 14220 requires testing according to IS 11346. Absent from tender.

suggested_fix.replacement_clause_text: Performance and hydrostatic testing shall be conducted strictly in accordance with IS 11346.
suggested_fix.recommended_action_summary: Incorporate standard-required test method IS 11346 into inspection clauses.

findings.title: Standard-Required Acceptance Test Standard Omitted: IS 9283
findings.tender_text: Section 7: Quality Assurance & Inspection (Test method standard absent)
findings.explanation: The governing product standard IS 14220 explicitly stipulates that hydraulic performance, tolerances, and acceptance tests shall be conducted in accordance with IS 9283 (Line Operated A.C. Motors for Submersible Pumpsets — Specification). Omitting this standard leaves test methodologies and tolerance bands legally unanchored.

evidence.factual_summary: Standard IS 14220 requires testing according to IS 9283. Absent from tender.

suggested_fix.replacement_clause_text: Performance and hydrostatic testing shall be conducted strictly in accordance with IS 9283.
suggested_fix.recommended_action_summary: Incorporate standard-required test method IS 9283 into inspection clauses.

findings.title: Mandatory BIS ISI Mark Omitted under Pumps (Quality Control) Order, 2023
findings.tender_text: The tender specification does not stipulate mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI mark) licensing for the equipment.
findings.explanation: Under statutory order S.O. 4333(E) (Pumps (Quality Control) Order, 2023) issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), it is legally mandatory that goods cannot be manufactured, imported, or procured without a valid BIS Standard Mark (ISI mark) under Scheme I. Omitting this requirement creates legal non-compliance and permits uncertified equipment.

evidence.factual_summary: Statutory Quality Control Order S.O. 4333(E) published in The Gazette of India: Extraordinary, Part II—Section 3—Sub-section (ii), S.O. 4333(E). Mandatory ISI Mark: True.

suggested_fix.replacement_clause_text: Bidders must possess a valid Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Standard Mark (ISI mark) license under Scheme I of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018 for IS 14220 as mandated by Pumps (Quality Control) Order, 2023.
suggested_fix.recommended_action_summary: Mandate compulsory BIS ISI certification in technical eligibility and delivery terms.

findings.title: Ambiguous / Qualitative Specification Phrase: 'superior engineering workmanship'
findings.tender_text:
6.4 [INTENTIONALLY VAGUE REQUIREMENT]:
    "The entire assembly shall be manufactured with superior engineering workmanship, excellent corrosion
resistance, and high-grade durable components to ensure long trouble-free service life under harsh village
conditions."
findings.explanation: The clause uses the unquantified phrase 'superior engineering workmanship'. Subjective specification language creates audit ambiguity, prevents objective lab testing, and can lead to supplier disputes.

evidence.factual_summary: Unquantified qualitative requirement 'superior engineering workmanship' without objective standard reference.

suggested_fix.replacement_clause_text: [Draft Replacement]: Replace 'superior engineering workmanship' with explicit parameters per Specify standard workmanship clauses from IS 14220 Clause 6 or relevant BIS code..
suggested_fix.recommended_action_summary: Replace ambiguous phrasing with quantifiable requirements (Specify standard workmanship clauses from IS 14220 Clause 6 or relevant BIS code.).

evidence.factual_summary: Unquantified qualitative requirement 'standard commercial grade' without objective standard reference.

suggested_fix.replacement_clause_text: [Draft Replacement]: Replace 'standard commercial grade' with explicit parameters per Specify exact metallurgical grades conforming to IS 14220 Table 2 (e.g. FG 200 for grey iron, AISI 410 for shaft)..
suggested_fix.recommended_action_summary: Replace ambiguous phrasing with quantifiable requirements (Specify exact metallurgical grades conforming to IS 14220 Table 2 (e.g. FG 200 for grey iron, AISI 410 for shaft).).
